entries.title: Recto Bank of America (Georgetown D.C.) 3 dollars 1852 urn-3 HBS.Baker.AC 1124374.jpeg
entries.description: Printed on white paper in black ink with the work "THREE" in red ink. Images include: a portrait of George Washington; Liberty sitting on a cornucopia of coins holding a portrait of George Washington and a staff with a Phrygian cap in her right hand and holding a laurel wreath over the head of an eagle with her left hand. The eagle holds a shield and olive branch in its talons and a banner in its beak. Behind them are a building, bridge, railroad, steamship, and sailing ship. Another image shows Liberty standing with a shield, staff, and Phrygian cap.

entries.title: Bank of Australasia Interior, Toogoolawah, Queensland QUT-6668-2.jpg
entries.description: These photographs show the exterior and the interior of the Bank of Australasia, Toogoolawah, Queensland. Jack Bain worked for the Bank of Australasia and worked in many branches over his career from the 1920s to his retirement in 1966. The Bank of Australasia building was frist constructed as a timber builiding and burnt down in November 1926. It was rebuilt as a contemporary concrete and timber building and re-opened in 1928. In 1951 the bank changed its name to the ANZ Bank. In 2002 it closed and more to the adjacent builidng wwhen NAB left Toogoolawah. Since 2003 the building has been a an art gllaery, a restaurant and Day Spa. The building is currently an AIRBNB for tourist accomodation. This branch of the Australasia Bank was destroyed by fire in November 1926 and was rebuilt in 1928.
entries.creator: Jack Bain

entries.title: Bank of the West Los Altos branch exterior.jpg
entries.description: Exterior of the Bank of the West vault in downtown Los Altos, California, demolished in March 2011. However, In an unrelated story The Telegraph in the U.K. reported that the movie used the old Midland Bank headquarters in London.
